name: @joeybuilt/fylo-bridge
description: Forwards Plexo synthesis budget signals to Fylo for budget tracking.
author: Joeybuilt LLC

capabilitiesRationale.storage:read: Reads the Fylo connection credentials (fylo_user_id) to authenticate data API calls.
capabilitiesRationale.events:subscribe: Subscribes to ext.synthesis-promote.fylo.budget.signal so Plexo's synthesis loop can promote a recurring spend pattern → Fylo budget signal.
